title: dianthus caryophyllus var. boissieri
intro: Dianthus caryophyllus var. boissieri, commonly known as the Sweet William or Carnation, is a fragrant, flowering plant species in the carnation family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality due to its sedative properties. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an antiseptic, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating coughs, colds, and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of Dianthus caryophyllus var. boissieri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
